facts.fact: Decreto Presidencial n.º 214/16, published 10 October 2016 and in force on publication, approves the Estatuto Orgânico of the APD and supplements the agency's duties under article 44 of Lei n.º 22/11.

The Estatuto sets the APD up as a public-law body with legal personality and a seven-member Conselho de Administração (three named by the executive, three elected by the National Assembly, one judge), without naming any appointee.
